``` {r}
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(htmltools)

leaflet(data) %>%
  addTiles(
urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
 attribution = "© Esri, National Geographic, DeLorme, NAVTEQ, UNEP-WCMC, USGS, NASA, ESA, METI, NRCAN, GEBCO, NOAA, iPC"
) |>
  setView(lng = 10.5, lat = 56.0, zoom = 7) %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    color = "darkred",
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    label = ~lapply(paste0(
      "<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>",
      Date_of_Accusation, " — ", Location_of_Case
    ), HTML),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>",
      "<b>Date:</b> ", Date_of_Accusation, "<br>",
      "<b>Gender:</b> ", Gender, "<br>",
      "<b>Location:</b> ", Location_of_Case, "<br>",
      "<b>Charge:</b> ", Charge, "<br>",
      "<b>Result:</b> ", Result_of_Case
    )
  )
```
```{r}
library (leaflet)
library (readr)
library (htmltools)

data <- Witchcraft_geocoding
  data$Gender <- factor(data$Gender, levels = c("Female", "Male", "Unknown"))
  pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("firebrick", "steelblue", "gray"),  # now matches levels() order exactly
  domain = data$Gender
)
```

``` {r} 
leaflet(data) %>%
  addTiles(
urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
 attribution = "© Esri, National Geographic, DeLorme, NAVTEQ, UNEP-WCMC, USGS, NASA, ESA, METI, NRCAN, GEBCO, NOAA, iPC"
) |>
  setView(lng = 10.5, lat = 56.0, zoom = 7) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~pal(Gender),
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~lapply(paste0("<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>", Date_of_Accusation), HTML),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>",
      "Date: ", Date_of_Accusation, "<br>",
      "Gender: ", Gender, "<br>",
      "Location: ", Location_of_Case, "<br>",
      "Charge: ", Charge, "<br>",
      "Result: ", Result_of_Case
    )
  ) %>%
addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~Gender,
    title = "Gender",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
``` 

``` {r}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# collapse all 1590 København people into one row
cph_1590_summary <- cph_1590 %>%
  summarise(
    latitude = first(latitude),
    longitude = first(longitude),
    n_people = n(),
    names_list = paste(Name_of_Accused, collapse = "<br>")
  )

leaflet(cph_1590_summary) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>København, 1590 — ", n_people, " accused</b><br><br>", names_list)
  )

cph_1590_summary <- cph_1590 %>%
  summarise(
    latitude = first(latitude),
    longitude = first(longitude),
    n_people = n(),
    names_list = paste0(Name_of_Accused, " — ", Result_of_Case, collapse = "<br>")
  )
```
``` {r}
leaflet(cph_1590_summary) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    label = ~paste0(n_people, " accused (1590)"),   # shows on hover
    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE),      # always visible, not just on hover
    popup = ~paste0("<b>Names:</b><br>", names_list)  # full list on click
  )
```

``` {r}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# 1. define Gender factor + palette FIRST, before building the map
df$Gender <- factor(df$Gender, levels = c("Female", "Male", "Unknown"))

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("firebrick", "steelblue", "gray"),
  domain = df$Gender
)

df_rest <- df %>%
  filter(!(Date_of_Accusation == 1590 & grepl("benhavn", Location_of_Case)))

cph_1590_summary <- df %>%
  filter(Date_of_Accusation == 1590, grepl("benhavn", Location_of_Case)) %>%
  summarise(
    latitude = first(latitude),
    longitude = first(longitude),
    n_people = n(),
    names_list = paste0(Name_of_Accused, " — ", Result_of_Case, collapse = "<br>")
  )

leaflet(df) %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attribution = "© Esri, National Geographic, DeLorme, NAVTEQ, UNEP-WCMC, USGS, NASA, ESA, METI, NRCAN, GEBCO, NOAA, iPC"
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = 10.5, lat = 56.0, zoom = 7) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = df_rest,
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~pal(Gender),      # <-- this was missing; now actually colors by gender
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>",
                     Date_of_Accusation, " — ", Location_of_Case, "<br>",
                     Result_of_Case)
  ) %>%
  addMarkers(
    data = cph_1590_summary,
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='max-height:200px; overflow-y:auto;'>",
      "<b>København, 1590 — ", n_people, " accused</b><br><br>",
      names_list,
      "</div>"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = df$Gender,
    title = "Gender",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
``` {r}
library(dplyr)

male_clusters <- df %>%
  filter(Gender == "Male") %>%
  count(Location_of_Case, latitude, longitude, name = "n_men") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_men))

head(male_clusters, 10)   
```
```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

leaflet(df) %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/NatGeo_World_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attribution = "© Esri, National Geographic, DeLorme, NAVTEQ, UNEP-WCMC, USGS, NASA, ESA, METI, NRCAN, GEBCO, NOAA, iPC"
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = 10.5, lat = 56.0, zoom = 7) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~pal(Gender),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(),   # <-- this is the fix
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", Name_of_Accused, "</b><br>",
                     Date_of_Accusation, " — ", Location_of_Case, "<br>",
                     Result_of_Case)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = df$Gender, title = "Gender", position = "bottomright")
```
